nodes.description: uint public state variable that acts as the sole source of randomness and is mutated by getRandomNumber
public function that mixes uint(blockhash(entropy % block.number)) into the state variable entropy via XOR and returns it
entropy ^= uint(blockhash(entropy % block.number)) — generation of a pseudo-random value from miner/block-influenceable data (blockhash, block.number)

edges.reason: getRandomNumber reads the state variable entropy, which is the only entropy source; the resulting randomness is derived from block data (blockhash/block.number) that miners/validators can influence, making the outcome predictable and manipulable.
The body of getRandomNumber unconditionally executes the entropy update operation on every call.
The value computed from blockhash(entropy % block.number) is written back into the state variable entropy, mutating persistent state on each invocation.
